title: epan+ftypes: Use unsigned proto_item_[set|get]_len
description:
The field_info struct already stores its length as unsigned.

Have proto_item_get_len return 0 instead of -1 when the item is
faked. Note that none of the existing users test for -1, except
for the WSLua wrapped, which already converts the -1 result to 0.

proto_item_get_len is unreliable as it is, due to items being faked;
the only way in which it is used that is guaranteed to work is
increasing the length of a proto_item by nesting it in a
proto_item_set_len call (since the set call is also faked if the
item is faked.) We might want a function to handle that case.

Also change the FTYPE_PROTOCOL to store its length as unsigned.

Ping #20103

AI-Assisted: no
